speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Viral Syndrome in Pregnancy. The current presentation of fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise with normal liver function and platelets, but elevated WBC, is most consistent with a viral etiology common in pregnancy.
